en: Multi-view color postcard showing scenes from a traditional rural complex or ethnic restaurant: thatched huts and outdoor seating, people in modern casual clothes walking past whitewashed buildings, diners at rustic tables laden with food, musicians playing accordion, and women performing folk dances in richly decorated red and black traditional costumes. The title in a green panel at the top left is written in Cyrillic script.
